audit_role: independent source auditor of exact full-iteration-05 snapshot
verdict_scope: Source-supported fidelity; no unconditional playable-core completeness certification.

scope.included: Original Nemesis basic-board standard semi-cooperative core, six original characters; FAQ v2.2 dated 16.04.2025 base Rules/Actions/Rooms/Items, printed pp.2–4.

method.source_basis: Complete scoped authoritative sources and direct PDF icon/note inspections retained in this auditor context; current snapshot read in full and checked for overall consistency. Current Hand/Shoot rationale rechecked directly in both FAQ extraction and FAQ PDF Rules 9. No prior audit report was read or used as the evidence source.

checked_claims.summary_text: The Hand Serious Wound does not increase Basic Shoot cost **because Shoot is a Basic Action, not an Item Action**.
source_references: Official FAQ v2.2, 16.04.2025, printed p.2, Rules 9
Original manual p.13, Basic Actions: Shoot
checked_claims.evidence: The FAQ expressly says no additional Action is required because Shoot is a Basic action, not an Item action. Direct FAQ PDF and extraction agree.
checked_claims.consistency: Matches the summary Basic Shoot cost of one Action card plus one Ammo; does not imply exemption for actual Item Actions. The adjacent Motion Scanner exception retains its separate unique-reaction rationale from FAQ Items 7.

source_limitations.case: All eight Adult models in Combat when another Adult must appear
source_references: Original manual p.15, Additional notes about Intruder movement
source_limitations.assessment: Only noncombat Adults can be removed by the supplied remedy. No model-supply resolution for the all-in-Combat state is given; accurately disclosed.

source_limitations.case: Queen development adds an Egg after Nest destruction
source_limitations.assessment: No express reconciliation of added Egg with destroyed status/marker; accurately disclosed without invented restoration/permanence ruling.
The exception ends if they miss, leaving successful-attack Contamination grammatically uncertain. The supported miss exemption and unresolved success case are correctly distinguished.

source_limitations.case: Later death after re-locking pods following first-death unlock
source_references: Original manual p.12, First dead Character
source_limitations.assessment: First-versus-any-death wording conflicts. FAQ 25 clarifies repeated yellow-space unlock only. Summary accurately flags the remaining death-trigger conflict.
Supplied manual/FAQ do not contain a complete corpus of individual Action, Item, Objective, Wound, Weakness and character effects. Summary retains printed-component dependencies.

source_supported_fidelity.explanation: The exact new Hand/Shoot explanation is directly supported by FAQ Rules 9 and consistent with the Action classification/cost rules. Full current text remains consistent with the scoped manual and FAQ; no actionable source-supported correction identified.

complete_core.explanation: Four expressly disclosed reachable cases are not uniquely resolved by the supplied authoritative sources, and individual component text remains required. Source-fidelity PASS therefore cannot certify a unique playable answer for every core state or a standalone substitute for all cards. These are source/component limits, not omitted available authoritative resolutions.

overall_conclusion: PASS for source-supported fidelity of exact iteration-05 snapshot; unconditional complete-core coverage remains unproven for the unchanged listed source limitations.
